issues.description: The fixed-point conversion function fix_fix2float has inconsistent return types across artifacts: the example_program header declares it as returning float, while the tests header defines/implements it as returning double. This mismatch appears in both the template and solution repositories (separate copies under example_program/src and tests/src). Because multiple translation units include different declarations/definitions, students may encounter confusing compiler warnings or ODR/linker problems and will be uncertain which type to use in their implementations and tests.
issues.suggested_fix: Unify the function signature for fix_fix2float across all headers/implementations. Choose one return type (preferably the one used in the implementation in example_program/src/math_fix.c, i.e. float) and update tests/src/math_fix.h to declare/define fix_fix2float returning float (and adjust any code that depends on it if necessary). Ensure all headers (example_program and tests) use the identical prototype so students and the build system see the same API.
